name: Two-Handed Pinochle
summary: Two-player trick-taking and melding game using a double 48-card pack with trumps and stock.
rules_text: Use 48 cards: two copies each of A,10,K,Q,J,9 in four suits. Deal 12 each, turn next card as trump, rest is stock face down. Non-dealer leads. Any card may be played, need not follow until stock empty. Higher card of led suit or higher trump wins trick, except trump led wins unless beaten by higher trump. Winner draws first from stock, opponent draws, restoring to 12. After winning a trick and before drawing, player may make one meld from hand plus tabled cards: flush 150, royal marriage 40, marriage 20, dix 10, 100 aces, 80 kings, 60 queens, 40 jacks, pinochle Qs-Jd 40, double pinochle 300. Card once melded stays tabled but may be played. Card can be reused only in different class or higher meld in same class. After stock gone, last 12 tricks must follow suit if able and must beat trump lead if able, must trump if cannot follow. Score melds immediately, plus trick points: A 11, 10 10, K 4, Q 3, J 2, last trick 10. Round scores rounded to 10, with 125-125 counting 120 each.
rating_reason: Classic trick-taking with melding, hidden hands, strategic.
